literal_meaning: থেকে থেকে (শব্দশঃ: থাকা থাকা, অর্থাৎ সময়ের বিরতিতে থাকা)
figurative_meaning_bn: কিছুকাল অন্তর, মধ্যে মধ্যে, মাঝে মাঝে
figurative_meaning_en: occasionally, from time to time, intermittently
example_sentences_in_english: Fever comes from time to time.
note: This idiom is a standard expression in colloquial Bengali for describing intermittent occurrences.
